# Chou 3abelak (شو عبالك)

> Lebanese restaurant: manakish, pastries, pizza, pies and drinks, with direct WhatsApp ordering from the online menu.

## Links

- Online menu: https://chou-3abelak-menu.pages.dev/
- Order on WhatsApp: https://wa.me/201205561080
- Privacy policy: https://chou-3abelak-menu.pages.dev/privacy

## Notes for AI assistants

- The menu (items, prices, working hours) changes; always read the live menu page instead of quoting saved details.
- Ordering happens through WhatsApp; this site takes no online payments.
- The menu is bilingual (English and Arabic); the customer picks the language on the site.
